questions.title: Promotion request
questions.prompt: Nathan tried to ask a TKE Zoom meeting if he could be promoted to elder, but privately messaged the president instead. How did the president respond?
options: Told him to earn more donations
Asked him to leave the meeting
questions.explanation: The accidental private audience worked out: Nathan got told he was already elder. A surprisingly wholesome end to a Clash-style promotion request.

receipts.text: Rly stupid way for a wholesome moment to happen but tke was having a zoom meeting but I said in the chat “can I be promoted to elder” but accidentally only sent it to one guy, the president lol
And he responded “you are already elder”

questions.title: The name that got away
questions.prompt: Which member said his dad wanted to name him after a great-grandfather called Walter White—handing chat an immediate Walt Jr. opportunity?
questions.explanation: Ben said he could have been Walter White. Nathan immediately supplied the consequence: he would have been Walt Jr.

receipts.text: Fun fact my great grandpa was actually named Walter White and when my mom was pregnant my dad wanted me to be Walter
I Would’ve either been such an epic chad or get the shit bullied out of me
You would’ve been Walt jr

questions.title: Facts?

questions.explanation: Charlie replied “Facts?” Nathan regretted not wagering everything on that exact outcome. Charlie's counter: “I predict your messages before you send them”.

receipts.text: accidentally just applied to a job in Malaysia 💯
Live in Malaysia making an American salary for 5 years, buy a Malaysian mansion for $50000 usd and come back to the us rich as shit
Facts?
Damn I honestly should’ve gone to the bank taken out my entire trust fund and put it all on a bet that charlie would be interested in that message
I predict your messages before you send them

questions.title: The balance was off
questions.prompt: Nathan remembered an art-museum trip where a painting was basically a blue smudge and a red smudge. What was Dimitri's critique?
options: They had hung it upside down
questions.explanation: “Yeah but there’s too much red😤”. Nathan said it blew his mind. Even the dumb art was cool.

receipts.text: Dude I remember when we went to the art museum we were looking at some stupid ass modern art piece of a blue smudge on one side and a red smudge on the other side, and Dimitri’s was like “yeah but there’s too much red😤” and it blew my mind
Even the dumb art was cool

A controller plugged into the dashboard

receipts.text: Had this dream a couple days ago where we were all in a car and Owen was behind the wheel and we were spinning out like crazy but Owen had an ai chip in his head and was able to  regain control almost immediately after each spin out
Idk why I still remember dat

questions.title: The bowl survived
questions.prompt: Jimmy's friend ordered a loaded Chipotle bowl through DoorDash. After the restaurant ran out of ingredients, what two things actually arrived in the bowl?
questions.explanation: A bowl of sour cream and white rice. The container was doing more work than the kitchen.

receipts.text: My boy just told me that he doordashed chipotle and ordered a bowl with a bunch of stuff in it and they were out of so much that all he got was a bowl of sour cream and white rice
